author: Jason Stys
summary: Group coverage-aware runtime alert episodes and retain exact reasoned human dispositions without changing original alert priorities.
rationale: Makes alert triage practical while preserving evidence gaps and detection provenance.
limitations: Source-health declarations and analyst dispositions are assertions, not attested incidents or proof of safety.
Capture gaps lack exact timestamps, so source alerts are conservatively kept separate rather than merged across uncertain gaps.
Pseudonyms and episode IDs apply to one exact saved review; no persistent key management or cross-review identity linkage is supplied.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
